displayPattern: Display on a Samsung dishwasher with a half-load function: PE
meaning: Half load failed: Samsung says the half-load function is not performing correctly.
causes: The half-load function is not performing correctly
diySteps: Add detergent and run a half load cycle
This is the half-load code. It is not the leak code and not the heater codes
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If PE still occurs after the empty half-load cycle, Samsung says to switch off power to the dishwasher at the circuit breaker and request service. The half-load steps apply to models that have that function.
sourceTitle: Samsung dishwasher is displaying an error code (Samsung Support)
